search_text: published ZDI-23-213 ZDI-CAN-19830 SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor WorkerControllerWCFProxy Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-03-07 CVE-2022-47503 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-47503 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['SolarWinds'] ['Network Performance Monitor'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WorkerControllerWCFProxy function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. SolarWinds has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor WorkerControllerWCFProxy Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Network Performance Monitor. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WorkerControllerWCFProxy function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
